Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Neeta - 64 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Vinod - 30 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Shalini - 27 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Rajesh stands in the ward. Neeta stands near him.]

Rajesh: "What lovely weather!"

[Rajesh walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Rajesh: "That's easy."

[Rajesh coughs and holds his chest.]

Neeta: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

Rajesh: "What a nice place."

[Rajesh is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Vinod: "This is amazing!"

[Rajesh steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Neeta: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rajesh stands in the living room. Vinod stands near him.]

Rajesh: "Vinod, look over here."

[Rajesh plays dead to fool his sister.]

Rajesh: "Exactly right."

[Rajesh's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Rajesh: "Hmm, I see."

[Rajesh laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Vinod: "One more time!"

Scene 4: The office - Day

[Rajesh stands in the office. Neeta and Shalini stand near him.]

Rajesh: "What a nice place."

[Rajesh sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Rajesh: "That was fun!"

[Rajesh answers the phone at his desk.]

Rajesh (happily): "Really?"

[Rajesh stretches after hours at the computer.]

Rajesh: "Show me too!"

[Rajesh shakes hands with the new client.]

Rajesh: "That was such a fun day!"
